items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying the first seven axioms the cycle class map commutes with pushforward along the projectivization of a vector bundle over a nonempty equidimensional base (statement lines 5025-5031). The proof (proof lines 5032-5061) reduces to the standard generators, applies the projection formula, and verifies the condition defining the degree map using the computation of the class of the diagonal of the projective bundle. H3: a three step reduction with a verification through the diagonal class, written out in full.
